fusions.name: Rolled Plate
fusions.desc: Rolls into a ball and spins, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Scale
fusions.desc: Flicks a shed plate at the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage and leaving it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Curled Atoll
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Seams Fused
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
